notes_for_editor: Thin record: one Register page plus one marker, and no staffing or fire history found. Brief status 'standing' is not stated in the NHLR text, so it is set to unknown. Relocation year is only 'late 80's' in the Register, so no relocated event is recorded. Brief elevation 76.5 m vs NHLR 251 ft (77 m) is rounding only. Towerdex/FCC antenna records in Millington (IDs 1313062 and 1314084) are not confirmed as this tower and are not used. Access: no public information found. Story now says anyone interested should contact the administrator before going near the tower. Fact-check 2026-10-09: removed the unsourced 'should not climb' advice and changed 'stands in' to 'is in', because the Register does not state current condition.
